title: fleet-patrols: board-snapshot fails its count check on every scheduled run since at least 2026-10-27 (11 of 11, exit 2), so the patrol is permanently red
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a tooling defect with a reproduction: every scheduled run reproduces it. Filed by the triage seat from its schedule-health read. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason

The board archive is the record a seat reads when the live board is not to hand, and the patrol that keeps it is the alarm for a drifting archive. A patrol that is red on every run can no longer raise that alarm: a real drift would look exactly like today's red. The other three sweeps in the same workflow share the run's status.

## Measured

`Fleet Patrols` → job "Snapshot the board to the archive branch", on every scheduled snapshot fire read:
- 10-27: 08:32, 14:28 and 20:18.
- 10-28: 02:23, 08:23, 14:18 and 20:18.
- 10-29: 02:23, 08:23, 14:19 and 20:18.

Each is a **failure, `board-snapshot` exit 2: "a failed count check (the archive and the board disagree about how many open issues exist)"**. In each run the archive was still committed and synced to R2 (for example 419 files at 14:19 and 500 at 20:18 on 10-29), so no record is lost. The runs at 16:29 and 04:2x are other crons, where this job is `skipped`. None of them is a green snapshot.

## Wanted

- Measure **why** the counts disagree on every run. One candidate is a race: cards created or closed during the minutes-long read, on a board that takes dozens of writes an hour. Another is a real, persistent drift (for example a class of issue the archive never holds).
- Fix the cause:
  - If it is the race, compare against a count taken consistently with the read window. Issues created or closed inside the window are accounted for by their timestamps.
  - If it is real drift, repair the archive and say what drifted.
- ⛔ Do not loosen the check into a tolerance that would also hide a real drift. ⛔ Do not mark the step `continue-on-error`.
- Acceptance: the next scheduled snapshot runs green, with the summary showing the two counts equal or the window accounted for.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:skills` lane: `scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs` is non-gate PM tooling. If the fix touches the `fleet-patrols.yml` wiring, that is governed and Tier H.

## Dedupe

Read every open issue whose title or body names `board-snapshot`, `board snapshot`, `count check` or `Fleet Patrols`. The only hit is #27479, which is about retired workflow file names in ui script comments. No card covers this.
